caption:
Google has launched the Gemini 3.7 Flash model, boasting significant coding improvements. This new model is priced at 50% less than its predecessor, Gemini 3.6 Flash, making it more accessible.

With benchmark scores of 43.6% on FrontierCode and 65.3% on DeepSWE, it surpasses competitors like Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra.

Should companies prioritize cost-effective AI solutions like this?

Sources: The Decoder, Google Blog
